question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Laison** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**Liaison**". • The word means a person who acts as a link to assist communication or cooperation between groups of people. • **Example**: *Liaison between departments improved efficiency.* • The word is commonly used in military and diplomatic contexts. Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 1**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Lieutenant **refers to a deputy or subordinate officer in the armed forces. (सशस्त्र बलों में एक उप या अधीनस्थ अधिकारी) • **Entrepreneur **refers to a person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit. (वह व्यक्ति जो लाभ की आशा में वित्तीय जोखिम उठाते हुए कोई व्यवसाय स्थापित करता है) • **Fluorescents **refers to a type of light bulb that produces visible light by using a mercury vapour discharge. (एक प्रकार का प्रकाश बल्ब जो पारा वाष्प निर्वहन का उपयोग करके दृश्य प्रकाश उत्पन्न करता है) 34:T701, The correct answer is: **B, A, D, C.**
